name: Status indicator
summary: A coloured dot with a label for presence or state: online, busy, away, offline, with an optional pulse.
description: Use it for people's presence and for live states such as a stream or a service. It can sit on an avatar's corner. For a status that is a word on its own, a badge may read better.

classes.name: v-status
classes.description: A dot before its label. Online (success colour) by default.

classes.name: v-status-offline
classes.description: Offline: a hollow ring in the muted colour, so it differs by shape too.

classes.name: v-status-pulse
classes.description: Adds a slow ring around the dot, for live states.

classes.name: v-status-avatar
classes.description: Wraps an avatar and a .v-status; the dot sits on the end corner with a ring in the surface colour.

a11y: The label carries the meaning; on an avatar keep it as .v-sr-only text inside the .v-status.
Offline is a hollow ring, not just a grey dot, so the states differ by shape as well as colour.
If the status changes live, announce the change in a role="status" region rather than making every dot a live region.
